From: mail01@anchorpoint.example
Sent: 2026-10-08 10:45:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@kestrelharbor.example
Subject: RE: VSL-03 - SURVEY QUOTATION HOLD NO.4 HATCH COVER HOSE TEST

Dear Colleagues,

The correspondent: appoint the surveyor; do not comment to the receiver; the master's rain and weather log for the voyage is needed.

- Asks: master's rain and weather log

Best regards,
Anchor Point Club Correspondents

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@kutchsurvey.example
Sent: 2026-10-03 15:00:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@anchorpoint.example
Cc: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Subject: RE: VSL-03 - SURVEY QUOTATION HOLD NO.4 HATCH COVER HOSE TEST

Dear Sirs,

Surveyor quotes USD 2,950 for a hatch cover hose test and inspection of hold no.4 coamings at the next port; proposes attendance on 14 Oct.

- Survey quote: 2950 USD
- Survey date: 2026-10-14

Best regards,
Gulf of Kutch Marine Surveyors

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@anchorpoint.example
Sent: 2026-09-29 09:10:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@kestrelharbor.example
Subject: VSL-03 MUNDRA - RECEIVER'S LETTER ALLEGING SEAWATER IN HOLD NO.4

Dear Colleagues,

The correspondent forwards the receiver's letter: coal from hold no.4 arrived with moisture 11.2% against 9.0% at load; receiver alleges seawater ingress and reserves rights; no amount claimed yet.

- Hold no: 4
- Discharge moisture: 11.2 %
- Load moisture: 9.0 %

Best regards,
Anchor Point Club Correspondents
